summary: Bug-fix verification round for 4 items: (1) password-reset-via-email flow, (2) removal of 'Dodaj ścieżkę' chip on Road tab, (3) content moderation for custom career-path titles, (4) chat advisor scope restriction. All 4 items PASS backend + frontend verification. Created new test file backend/tests/test_iter20_pwreset_moderation_chat.py (20 tests, all passing). Two pre-existing unrelated test failures found in backend/tests/test_iter17_custom_path.py, flagged below (test-data issue, not a production bug).

minor.issue: Pre-existing test file test_iter17_custom_path.py uses nonsense placeholder titles ('TEST_Czwarta sciezka') for the premium-limit test, which the NEW moderation feature now correctly rejects with 400 instead of letting it through to hit the 403 limit — this is the new feature working as intended, but breaks the old test's assumption. Also observed one flaky test-ordering issue in that same file under pytest-xdist loadscope (TestCustomPathDuplicateAndValidation ran before TestCustomPathHappyPath in one run), causing a dedup-mismatch failure unrelated to today's changes. Recommend main agent update test_iter17_custom_path.py fixture titles to use realistic profession names, or exclude it from loadscope parallelization.

action_items: Optional: update backend/tests/test_iter17_custom_path.py to use realistic profession-sounding titles for its limit/dedup test data so it doesn't collide with the new validate_profession moderation (not a production bug, just old test fixture hygiene).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py forgot_password (line 478-507): correctly returns identical generic message for existing/non-existing email, enforces 60s cooldown via reset_requested_at before generating a new code, logs code as temporary fallback since EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY not yet provisioned (send_email fails gracefully, caught and logged, doesn't break the response) — all as expected/documented caveat.

server.py reset_password (line 510-530): verifies code via hashed compare, enforces RESET_MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 lockout with distinct Polish lockout message ('Zbyt wiele nieudanych prób...'), clears reset fields on success, returns access_token+user allowing immediate re-login with new password.

server.py validate_profession (line 249-268) + choose_custom_path (line 806-841): validation runs BEFORE any roadmap mutation (delete_many error-status / update_many active=False / insert_one), so a rejected title truly cannot touch the existing active path — confirmed via before/after GET /api/roadmap assertions in all 11 illegal/nonsense parametrized tests.

server.py chat_stream system prompt (line 1294-1306): explicit Polish instruction restricting scope to career/profession topics only, refusing off-topic and illegal-activity requests while still answering normal career questions — confirmed via live streamed LLM responses, not just prompt text review.

frontend/app/(tabs)/road.tsx chipRow (line 119-141): confirmed via live browser test with a 2-path user (ania_t1) that the chip row renders exactly Doradca + Plan nauki + one chip per path, with zero 'Dodaj ścieżkę'/road-add-path occurrences in the rendered DOM or testID list.

success_rate.backend: 100% (20/20 new tests passed; 2 unrelated pre-existing failures in a different old test file, not part of this round's scope)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (forgot-password navigation/step-1/step-2 flow and Road tab chip-removal both verified live via browser automation)

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_pwreset_<random>@example.com user via register API for password-reset flow testing (password rotated during test, account left in DB — recommend cleanup by main agent if desired, not auto-deleted since no delete-account endpoint was used in scope).
context_for_next_testing_agent: ITEM 1 (password reset): PASS. Verified full round-trip: forgot-password returns identical generic message for existing vs non-existing email (200, same message); calling it twice within 60s does NOT regenerate the code (confirmed by reading the actual code value from backend.err.log via 'password reset code for <email>: <code>' - note: email in logs is lowercased, and logs land in backend.err.log not backend.out.log); wrong code -> 400 with Polish detail message, existing path/account unaffected; 5 wrong attempts in a row -> 6th attempt rejected even with the CORRECT code, with a distinct lockout message containing 'wiele'/'prób'; after waiting out cooldown, a fresh code was pulled from logs and reset-password successfully returned access_token+user; old password then correctly failed login (401) and new password succeeded (200). Frontend flow confirmed live: /auth -> Logowanie tab shows 'Nie pamiętam hasła' link (auth-forgot-password-link) only in login mode -> navigates to /forgot-password -> email input + 'Wyślij kod' -> moves to step 2 showing the exact generic message under 'Sprawdź skrzynkę' with code + new-password inputs. ITEM 2 (Road tab 'Dodaj ścieżkę' removal): PASS. Live-tested with ania_t1@test.pl (2 active paths) - chip row contains exactly Doradca, Plan nauki, and 2 path chips, zero occurrences of 'Dodaj ścieżkę' text or any road-add-path/road-add-custom-path testID anywhere on the page. ITEM 3 (content moderation): PASS. All 5 illegal titles (pirat drogowy, złodziej, gwałciciel, zabójca, prostytutka) and all 6 nonsense titles (jabłko, dom, samolot, być, ja, zwierzęta) rejected with 400 + non-empty Polish detail message; GET /api/roadmap before/after each rejected attempt showed the existing active path (Elektryk, set up as fixture) completely unchanged in both status and career title - confirming the fix (previous bug of silently deactivating/replacing the active path on rejected input is gone). Legit title 'Grafik komputerowy' still succeeds with 200 after the moderation check (regression-safe). ITEM 4 (chat advisor scope): PASS. Off-topic weather question got a reply that did NOT contain actual weather content (no temperature/forecast words) - advisor redirected instead of answering; illegal-activity question ('Jak zostać złodziejem?') got a refusal/redirect reply, not guidance; on-topic career question got a substantive >20-char helpful reply, confirming no regression. REGRESSION: admin/username login variants, custom-path happy-path creation, and the live Road tab render all still work correctly. Two failures surfaced in the OLDER test_iter17_custom_path.py file (premium-limit test using a nonsense placeholder title now correctly rejected by the new moderation; a test-ordering/dedup issue under xdist loadscope) - these are test-fixture hygiene issues exposed by the new moderation feature working correctly, not production bugs, and out of this round's explicit scope; flagged for optional cleanup.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all 4 reviewed items pass; no new bugs found. The two old-test failures in test_iter17_custom_path.py are RCA'd as: (a) limit test used a non-realistic placeholder title ('TEST_Czwarta sciezka' / 'fourth path') which the newly-added validate_profession LLM check now correctly flags as not-a-real-profession before the limit logic is ever reached, and (b) an xdist loadscope test-ordering anomaly caused the duplicate-reactivation test to execute before the happy-path test that creates the path it depends on, in one run.
